title: Iron veins as a natural wiring network on the Giza Plateau

tellings.quote: It all emanates from the core of the central pyramid and the Great Pyramid and it spreads all across the Giza plateau connecting all of these various structures.

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man who says an alien showed him what the pyramids were really for, told podcast host Jesse Michels that veins of iron run through the rock of the Giza Plateau in Egypt, where the great pyramids stand. He says these veins spread out from the central pyramid and the Great Pyramid and link all the structures across the plateau, like natural wiring. If true, the pyramids would have been built as parts of a single energy network rather than as tombs alone.
